source: in-session Claude Code agent (pred-scout-coach) over each artifact role view (kit, build, stages, Eternal, lane augment, matchup verdicts, honesty notes) only; every number ground-checked, failing lines dropped

support.line: Open with Imperial Lash to root and dash in, then Queen's Garden to trap them and Royal Flourish while they're stuck; hold Iron Rose for the damage reduction. Once Stonewall and Vainglory land by minute 21 you can front the fight.
support.watchout: Dive in without Iron Rose up against Dekker, Riktor or Mourn and you die first — wait for their engage.

offlane.line: Trade with Imperial Lash to root, then Royal Flourish to hold them still and Queen’s Garden to pin them for the kill. With Viper and Solaris done by minute 19, that chain actually kills squishies; before then, farm behind Iron Rose.
offlane.watchout: Every offlane matchup here reads theirs, so give ground and farm rather than lashing into a bruiser you cannot finish.

offlane.line: Open with Web Lash to root, close in for Crushing Maw at point-blank where it hits hardest and heals you, then Consume to pull and finish a low target. Crescelia by minute 18 makes Hellfire's chip worth poking with.
offlane.watchout: Every offlane matchup here reads theirs, so if Web Lash misses, walk out and farm instead of trading it out.

jungle.line: Open with Web Lash to root them, close with Crushing Maw for the heal, then Hellfire's slowing fireballs and Consume to finish anyone low. Build Hunger on camps first so you enter fights Awakened; Oathkeeper lands at minute 19.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera, Rampage and Feng Mao out-sustain you in a straight duel — poke with Hellfire and only commit once Consume can execute.

midlane.line: Open with Dread Nova to stun, drop Ether Crystal on them to slow and pull them back in, then hold Particle Shredder on one target so Disintegrate stacks. Timewarp and Oathkeeper by minute 24 let Synaptic Obliterator close out anyone hurt.
midlane.watchout: Every mid matchup reads theirs, so farm from range and only commit Dread Nova when a teammate can follow up.

support.line: Use Ether Crystal to protect your carry: it shoves attackers off them, then pulls them back in as it implodes, and follow with Dread Nova to stun. Stonewall and Warden's Faith by minute 21 let you block for them instead of backing away.
support.watchout: You are a ranged hero on a tank build, so if Ether Crystal is down, walk away rather than trade.

offlane.line: Open with Hoarfrost to root them, then Boreal Sweep for the slow and its delayed eruption, and finish with Cryoseism when they clump. Once Oathkeeper lands around minute 25, you can stay in the fight instead of trading once and leaving.
offlane.watchout: Zarus wins the straight brawl, so don't stand and fight him; use Glacial Charge to reposition and only commit when he's rooted or outnumbered.

jungle.line: Gank from the fog with Glacial Charge, drop Hoarfrost behind them so the root catches the retreat, then Boreal Sweep and let the Frost Storm tick. Orion by minute 18 means Cryoseism finishes anyone who stays.
jungle.watchout: Kwang is the coin-flip here, so skip the solo invade and take that fight only with your laner beside you.

support.line: Start fights with Glacial Charge, then Hoarfrost behind them so the root catches their retreat, and Boreal Sweep while your carry follows up. Stonewall and Inquisition by minute 21 let you open the fight instead of reacting.
support.watchout: Engaging before your carry is in range leaves you alone behind their team, so wait until they can follow you in before you use Glacial Charge.

offlane.line: Open with Skull Crusher to land the armour shred and the speed toward them, then Cursed Edge, keeping all three slashes on one target for the bleed. Pop Dire Howl before you take the trade; Viper by minute 19 makes Kingslayer finish.
offlane.watchout: Berserk only pays if you live through it, so against Greystone, Steel or Zarus back out at low health instead of committing.

jungle.line: Gank with Skull Crusher for the shred, follow with Cursed Edge so the third slash stuns, and cast Dire Howl before you take damage so it heals you afterwards. Solaris and Viper by minute 19 turn Kingslayer into the finisher.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang win the straight duel, so farm your own camps and gank lanes rather than invading them.

jungle.line: Start ganks with Detection Protocol so the trail speeds you in and the hit slows them, then Chrono Swipe in, Primeval Roar to fear, and Ursine Burst to grab their carry. Basic attacks between abilities keep Canisters healing you.
jungle.watchout: Every jungle matchup here reads theirs, so gank lanes rather than duel, and use the Detection Protocol speed to leave.

midlane.line: Poke with Eventide, then Shadow Slip in and spin Blade Siphon; two ability hits close together set Haemorrhage, and Feast on a bleeding target hits harder and heals you for the damage it deals. Keep the Shadow so you can swap straight back out.
midlane.watchout: Gideon and The Fey out-range you, so never Shadow Slip in without saving the swap to get you back out.

offlane.line: Open with Shadow Slip to close and slow, follow with Eventide and Blade Siphon to stack Haemorrhage, then Feast the weakest target. Once Oathkeeper lands by minute 24, Blade Siphon's healing keeps you alive through longer skirmishes.
offlane.watchout: Zarus out-trades you head-on, so don't duel him under his tower; farm the side wave and only commit with a teammate.

jungle.line: Open with Shadow Slip onto them, hit Blade Siphon and Eventide back-to-back so Blood Tithe applies Haemorrhage, then Feast to cash in the bonus damage and heal. Keep the Shadow as your escape; Oathkeeper lands at minute 24.
jungle.watchout: Dive a grouped team and Shadow Slip won't save you — swap back to the Shadow early or wait for a pick.

offlane.line: Close with Forward Crunch to stun, then weave a basic attack between every ability, since the amped hit adds damage and cuts your cooldowns, and Re-Crunch your best swing. Viper and Basilisk by minute 19 make that chain kill squishies.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Aurora and Zarus win this lane, so farm and punish their engage rather than dashing in first.

jungle.line: Dive with Forward Crunch to stun, then alternate Left Crunch and Right Crunch with a basic attack between each so cooldowns drop, and spend Turbo Crunch on the empowered swing. Basilisk by minute 19 makes the full chain kill.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera, Kwang and Feng Mao beat you head-on, so gank the sidelanes instead of contesting their side of the jungle.

support.line: Lead with Stasis Bomb from long range, since the further it travels the longer the stun, then Photon Disruptor to slow while your carry hits. Stonewall and Inquisition by minute 21 let you hold the front and cut escapes with Containment Fence.
support.watchout: If Stasis Bomb misses you have little to trade with, so back off behind Containment Fence rather than throwing more abilities.

carry.line: Poke with Old Rusty for the slow, turn on Rad Rounds and basic attack to stack Irradiate, then hit them with Old Rusty or Shrapnel Cannon to erupt it early. Deathstalker and Vanquisher by minute 25 make attacks your damage.
carry.watchout: Divers ignore boomerangs, so hold Gag Grenade's silence and the in-air Shrapnel Cannon knockback for whoever jumps you.

carry.line: Open at range where Tachyon Lance and Sidewind chip safely and build Heat, then Zero Shift into melee to finish, since Talon Drive and the claw chain heal you. Viper and Deathstalker by minute 25 make basic attacks the kill.
carry.watchout: Skylar, Murdock and Drongo out-range you, so stay ranged and farm rather than shifting to melee without an exit.

offlane.line: Farm and poke in ranged stance with Tachyon Lance, then Zero Shift to melee only once they are low, where Talon Drive and the claw chain heal you back. Sky Splitter and Viper by minute 19 make basic attacks your damage.
offlane.watchout: Every offlane matchup here reads theirs, so if a bruiser lands on you, shift ranged and give ground instead of trading.

jungle.line: Open with Reaping Dash to close, land Hamstring's double swing on one target for its bonus damage, then finish with Earth Shatter's execute. Save Safeguard to block their key ability; once Viper and Basilisk land around minute 19, your ganks kill outright.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera, Kwang and Kallari beat you in the jungle — invade with a teammate or farm the safe side instead.

offlane.line: Trade with Hamstring when only one enemy is in range — the single-target hit swings harder — then Reaping Dash in for the kill and hold Earth Shatter to execute. After Viper and Basilisk your all-in actually finishes them.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Aurora and Zarus win this lane — farm safely under tower and wait for your jungler rather than diving.

midlane.line: Root them with Security Gate, stick Sticky Mine on and land a Spark basic attack so the mine goes off empowered for the bigger hit, then Seek and Destroy as they run. Once Orion and Wraith Leggings land you can commit Tesla Dome on top.
midlane.watchout: Gideon and The Fey win this matchup — hold Security Gate for their engage and farm safely instead of trading mines.

midlane.line: Open with Void Breach to slow them, follow with Cosmic Rift, then land a basic attack — Cosmic Power tethers and roots them for the follow-up. Use Torn Space to reposition; once Caustica and Overseer land, Black Hole finishes fights.
midlane.watchout: Once Black Hole has finished channelling it can't be cancelled — don't open with it alone; wait for a teammate's stun or the enemy to commit first.

offlane.line: Leap in with Assault The Gates, drop Make Way underneath to shred armor, then cleave with Sacred Oath. Save Stone Forged Soul until you're low — it heals more the more health you're missing — and by minute 25 you can dive first.
offlane.watchout: Steel and Zarus win this lane — once you have spent Stone Forged Soul to heal up, back off instead of staying for another trade.

jungle.line: Gank with Assault The Gates — hitting a hero cuts its cooldown — then Make Way to shred armor and Sacred Oath to cleave. Stone Forged Soul heals you back up when a dive goes wrong; Krix adds tankiness, not damage.
jungle.watchout: Kwang beats you in a straight jungle fight — take his camps when he's shown elsewhere instead of contesting him face to face.

carry.line: Stay in Sentry Mode to stack attack speed, swap to Assault Mode for extra range and cleave, and let Pulsefire burst for true damage. Save Energy Shield for their engage; by minute 24 your sustained shooting carries fights.
carry.watchout: Assault Mode drains 30 mana per attack — if you're dry mid-fight you have no damage, so drop back to Sentry Mode.

offlane.line: Pull them in with Smash 'n Grab's stun, immediately Double Pain to heal off them, stack Bloodlust bleeds with basic attacks, then Warlord's Challenge to stun again. Solaris and The Perforator by minute 25 are when you stop trading and start killing.
offlane.watchout: Every offlane matchup here is against you — farm under tower to minute 25 and only fight when your jungler arrives.

jungle.line: Gank from a bush: Stampede in to drag them, Smash 'n Grab to stun, then Double Pain on every hero it touches to heal yourself back up. Warlord's Challenge extends the fight; Solaris by minute 19 keeps you swinging.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera, Kwang and Feng Mao win the 1v1 — bring a laner or take camps on the far side instead.

midlane.line: Zone with H11 Cluster Grenades, land Land Mine to knock them into your R2000 Missile, and weave a basic attack for Armed Salvo's bonus — each ability cast brings it back sooner. By minute 24 you can reposition and Make It Rain from safety.
midlane.watchout: Land Mine knocks you back too — mis-time it and you launch yourself into Gideon or The Fey, who already beat you.

midlane.line: Place Flame Turrets before the fight, roll Oil Spill through them, then Molotov the oil to ignite it — Slick stacks from your basic attacks make the burn hurt more. Inferno cleans up; Wraith Leggings by minute 24 keeps you out of reach.
midlane.watchout: Turrets melt to melee attacks — if someone jumps on you, hold Inferno's knockback instead of dropping turrets at your feet.

offlane.line: Lay Flame Turrets in the bushes, then Oil Spill across the lane and ignite it with Molotov to hold them off the wave. Basic attacks stack Slick for extra burn; Wraith Leggings by minute 25 lets you walk away from whoever jumps you.
offlane.watchout: Melee bruisers kill turrets fast — when one jumps you, save Inferno's knockback to shove them off you rather than burning it for damage.

carry.line: Drop Hydroclasm on them, let the bubble grow for a moment, then pop it with Brine to land both hits and a heavy slow. Lock them with Narcosis first; by minute 25 that pop alone takes a huge bite out of a squishy.
carry.watchout: Popping the bubble early wastes it — if they're already on you, use Genesis's knock-up to make space before you commit Brine.

midlane.line: Poke with Brine, then place Hydroclasm on their approach and pop it late with Brine for the amplified hit and slow. Narcosis suspends them for the follow-up; by minute 24 Oathkeeper turns that combo into a real kill threat.
midlane.watchout: Gideon and The Fey beat you here — hold Narcosis for when they close on you rather than spending it on poke.

jungle.line: Approach in Shadow Walk, open with Crippling Dagger to slow, then Shadow Dance onto the marked target — it hits twice as hard on a Death Mark — and Guillotine when they're low. After Viper and Solaris the burst kills outright.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang win a straight fight, and attacking ends Shadow Walk instantly — pick off their squishies instead of contesting camps face to face.

jungle.line: Jump in with Ambush — it hits harder the lower they are — pop Unleash for a burst of fast cleaving attacks, and keep attacking to build Rage so your cooldowns come back. Invigorate cleanses stuns; by minute 25 long fights are yours.
jungle.watchout: Rage drains fast when you stop attacking — disengaging mid-fight costs your speed and cooldowns, so commit or don't start it.

offlane.line: Ambush onto them when they're already hurt for the bigger hit, then Unleash and keep swinging to hold Rage up. Save Invigorate to cleanse their stun and heal, and Cull to lock them down once Spear Of Desolation lands.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Aurora and Zarus beat you in lane — farm and only Ambush when their escape is down or your jungler is close.

carry.line: Stack Vengeance with basic attacks and Mercy shots — each stack raises your damage — then cash it in with Dusk when they're nearly dead, since a kill resets it. Shadow Glide in and out; Purge closes fights after Vanquisher.
carry.watchout: Purge locks you out of everything except Shadow Glide and slows you — only cast it when they can't just walk away.

jungle.line: Throw Judgement of the Heavens to tether them, then Surge of the Heavens through the blade to recall it and knock them up. Hitting abilities Energizes your attacks, cutting cooldowns — by minute 24 you can chain that loop nonstop.
jungle.watchout: Fury of the Heavens teleports you to the blade, so throwing it deep then casting drops you alone in their whole team.

offlane.line: Poke with Judgement of the Heavens, then Surge of the Heavens into the blade to snap it back and knock them up. Landing an ability Energizes your blade, and the lightning basic attack that follows cuts your cooldowns; by minute 24 you can stand in the fight and keep swinging.
offlane.watchout: Zarus wins this lane and Fury of the Heavens teleports you to your blade — don't throw it past them while behind.

carry.line: Chip with the K-75 Storm Rifle, pausing to let the ammo refill, and lay Saturation Charge mines to slow anyone diving you. Pop Rally Point for the heal and unlimited ammo, and by minute 25 the penetration you've bought makes every shot hit harder.
carry.watchout: Every carry matchup here goes against you — hold Frag Order for when they close, and never cook it while their stun is up.

midlane.line: Open with Seismic Assault to stun, drop Void Bomb where they land, then Neural Disruptor — it hits harder the more mana Void Drone has drained. From Oathkeeper at minute 24 that chain threatens a squishy outright.
midlane.watchout: Miss Seismic Assault and you're stuck in the open against Gideon, The Fey or Iggy & Scorch — hold it until they commit.

support.line: Lead fights with Seismic Assault to stun the group, then Void Bomb the stunned cluster and save Neural Disruptor to punish whoever runs. With Stonewall and Vainglory done by minute 21 you can stand in front and take the hits.
support.watchout: Against Dekker don't walk up first — hold Seismic Assault to answer her engage instead of opening with it.

support.line: Poke with Maco Sparkle! from max distance for the longer stun, then Maco Gift! your carry for the heal and speed. Once Noxia and Oblivion Crown are up around minute 22, Maco Fly! becomes a safer engage because hitting a hero shields you.
support.watchout: If Maco Fly! misses every hero you get no shield, so don't lead with it into Dekker or Riktor; wait for their engage.

midlane.line: Open with Mark on the target, stack Pestilence with Hive and Swarm, then cast Curse to cash the Mark in. Swarm refreshes whenever it clips a hero, so use it to reposition; Soulbinder lands at minute 24.
midlane.watchout: Curse needs a channel and removes the Mark — cast it from behind your team, not while Gideon or The Fey can reach you.

support.line: Open with Abduct to drag someone out of position, follow with Beguile to hold them, then Contagion to heal your carry and strip their armor. Play poke between fights, and from Oblivion Crown at minute 29 that chip damage adds up.
support.watchout: Abduct's wind-up slows you and telegraphs the pull — against Dekker, Riktor or Narbash, channel from a bush or don't channel at all.

carry.line: Drop Static Trap on the path they must walk, then use Buckshot as they step in for the armor shred — it pushes them back, so keep your distance and keep basic attacking with Hot Pursuit up. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done by minute 19 those attack chains kill on their own.
carry.watchout: Buckshot pushes them away, so using it point-blank on a diver you want dead just saves them; save it to break an engage.

offlane.line: Hold the wave from range and place Static Trap where ganks come from, then Buckshot any diver away and leave with Hot Pursuit. Once Viper and Deathstalker land by minute 19 you can stand and trade instead of only poking.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Aurora and Zarus all come out ahead in this lane, so give up the wave, farm under tower and ask your jungler for help.

support.line: Shield your carry with Alacrity before the trade, drop Consecrated Ground under them, and charge Serenity 1.1s so it stuns instead of slows. Once Oblivion Crown and Lunaria land by minute 21, Reversal Of Fortune can rescue an ally from a lost fight.
support.watchout: Cancelling Serenity's charge refunds only half, so panicking mid-charge wastes it; against Dekker, Riktor or Mourn shield first and stun later.

support.line: Toggle Song Of My People to healing in lane and speed when you rotate, then land Thunk's stun to start a trade. Once Oblivion Crown and Spirit Of Amir land by minute 22, March! and Crash Bang Boom! turn a group fight your way.
support.watchout: Crash Bang Boom! slows you for the whole channel, so starting it in the open gets you focused; save it until their dashes are gone.

midlane.line: Cast three basic abilities to bank Threads, then spend the Overclocked one on Data Burst so it mesmerizes as well as slows. Dash in with Erase Vector for the empowered Jolt; from Oathkeeper at minute 18 that combo threatens a squishy.
midlane.watchout: Dashing in without Final Thread up leaves you standing in front of Gideon, The Fey or Iggy & Scorch — poke from range instead.

support.line: Attach Telekinetic Link to your carry and stay in range so you both keep the power bonus, then Psychic Flare to blind whoever turns on you. Once Stonewall and Vainglory land by minute 21 you can survive long enough to finish Energy Lance's root.
support.watchout: Energy Lance needs 8 stacks before the root lands, so channelling it while Dekker or Riktor is on you just gets you killed.

jungle.line: Carry Boulder Throw into a gank — Pounce while holding it to shatter the stun in an area — then Rumble to slow and swing. Save Behemoth for when you're surrounded; it heals more per enemy nearby, and The Perforator lands minute 25.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera, Kwang and Kallari take the checkpoints — don't duel them without Behemoth up; farm and gank the lanes instead.

midlane.line: Open with Stupor to mesmerize, drop Mortal Coil so the Soul Orb pulls and heals you, then Soulfire into it. Scoop the Essence from anything dying near you — it widens the orb and its execute; Magnify lands at minute 24.
midlane.watchout: Abyssal Rift's channel drops you into their team — save it for a fight already won, not as an escape from Gideon.

carry.line: Land Scar first, then work through the Marked stacks with Fate and Obliterate until the root lands. Reload with Hellfire Rounds between trades, and once Viper and Deathstalker land by minute 19 use Reckoning to isolate their carry.
carry.watchout: Reckoning locks you alone with the target, so pulling Sparrow, Skylar or Drongo, who beat you at checkpoints, hands them the kill.

support.line: Hook with Riplash to drag someone out of position, then Shock Therapy to silence and Electrocute for the shield while your carry follows up. Once Stonewall and Warden's Faith land by minute 21 you can walk in first and use Skewer on their backline.
support.watchout: Miss Riplash and you have no way to reach them, so against Dekker hold it for her engage rather than throwing it first.

jungle.line: Gank from a bush: Riplash the pull, Shock Therapy to silence, then hold Electrocute's aura on them while you basic attack. Once Spectra and Prophecy are done by minute 18 you can survive the counter-gank and use Skewer to lock their group.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang beat you at the checkpoints, so don't duel them for camps; take the far side and gank a lane instead.

offlane.line: Land Ashen Vow's outer edge to slow them and empower your next Cindara, dash in with First Intent for the shield, then Minueta to finish — the last stab hits harder the lower they are. Viper lands at minute 19.
offlane.watchout: Zarus wins the checkpoints — don't burn First Intent to engage him; keep it as the escape and shield refresh.

jungle.line: Clear camps with Ashen Vow's outer edge on the camp leader — it refunds Energy and empowers Cindara. Gank by restraining with Swan Song, dashing in with First Intent, then Minueta to finish; Spear Of Desolation lands at minute 25.
jungle.watchout: Kwang wins the checkpoints — don't invade him early; take your own camps and gank a lane where Swan Song can catch someone.

jungle.line: Open with Heaven's Fury to land on them, Chastise for the slow, then basic attack between casts. Once Viper and Solaris land by minute 19, turn on Heresy and chain kills; each takedown leaves a visage that refreshes it.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera, Kwang, Feng Mao and Kallari all beat you at checkpoints, so don't invade early; farm your own camps until Heresy is up.

offlane.line: Farm the wave with basic attacks and only use Ascend to dodge a skillshot or leave, not to engage. Once Viper and Solaris land by minute 19, look for a Heaven's Fury into Chastise on anyone who steps past their tower.
offlane.watchout: Every offlane matchup here goes against you, so treat lane as farming and call your jungler before you ever commit Heaven's Fury.

offlane.line: Open with Subjugate to chain them in place, Phantom Rush through to fear, then Siphon — every ability kill feeds Reaper of Souls health. Hold Colossal Blow to knock their diver off your carry; Oathkeeper lands at minute 25.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Aurora and Zarus win the checkpoints against you — farm Souls safely and fight only with Subjugate up.

jungle.line: Clear camps with Siphon — it hits monsters harder and stacks Souls — then gank by dropping Subjugate behind them so leaving it stuns. Phantom Rush to fear and finish with Colossal Blow; Oathkeeper lands minute 25.
jungle.watchout: Don't invade Khaimera or Kwang early — they win those checkpoints; take your own camps and gank the lanes instead.

offlane.line: Poke with Line Tempo, then dash in with Rushing Beat and spin up Circle Rhythm for the shield and repeat hits — every ability that touches a hero stacks Track toward All-Kill!. Orion lands at minute 24.
offlane.watchout: Save one Rushing Beat charge for the exit — dashing all-in against Greystone, Steel, Aurora or Zarus leaves you with no way out.

jungle.line: Open with RMB Rushing Beat to close, then Q Line Tempo and E Circle Rhythm for the shield — every ability hit builds Track toward All-Kill!. Once Timewarp lands around minute 18, those wolves come back fast enough to repeat the cycle each fight.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang beat you in a straight duel — don't dive them; poke with Line Tempo and commit only alongside a teammate.

carry.line: Stick Plasma Grenade on them, pop Hypercharge as it bursts, and hold Air Assault to hover out of melee range while you keep firing. Save Atomiser for a target already hurt; once Viper and Deathstalker land by minute 19, basic attacks carry the fight.
carry.watchout: Hypercharge does nothing if you're caught out of position — Murdock and Drongo outrange you, so wait out their poke before stepping up.

carry.line: Open Heightened Senses to close in stealth, then stack Relentless with basic attacks before Piercing Shot, and drop Hail of Arrows to slow anyone chasing. Once Vanquisher lands around minute 25, save Inner Fire for the full team fight.
carry.watchout: Murdock and Drongo outrange you early, so stay behind minions until Deathstalker and keep Heightened Senses for escaping rather than engaging.

offlane.line: Open with Bull Rush to knock them back into your minions, follow with Shield Bash for the stun, and put Force Shield in their escape path for the slow. Oathkeeper at minute 19 adds damage to that chain.
offlane.watchout: Against Aurora and Zarus don't lead with Bull Rush — you land in their lap with no dash left; hold it to disengage.

support.line: Open fights with Shield Slam onto their back line, then Shield Bash to keep the stun going and Bull Rush anyone walking at your carry. Force Shield blocks their ranged shots; Stonewall and Vainglory by minute 21 let you hold the front.
support.watchout: Dekker wins the lane checkpoints — don't engage first there; hold Shield Slam for after she commits and peel instead.

offlane.line: Lead with E Highland Hurl to slow and soften their armor, close with RMB Wild Rush, then spin Q Ruthless Assault — hits build Hersir, so save the empowered cast for a root. Once Viper and Deathstalker land by minute 19, basics finish it.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Aurora and Zarus all come out ahead in this lane, and Wild Rush needs up to a 3.5s wind-up, so don't open fights with it — use it to escape or follow up.

jungle.line: Open ganks with RMB Wild Rush from out of sight, then E Highland Hurl to slow and Q Ruthless Assault to grind them down. Once Viper and Deathstalker land by minute 19, stay in the fight longer — your basics do the killing.
jungle.watchout: Kwang beats you in a straight duel — don't invade his side alone; take your own camps and gank the lanes instead.

midlane.line: Open with Q Bramble Patch where they must walk, then poke with E Harvest Nettles — repeat hits on the same target hurt more. Land R Fly Trap on a clumped group; by minute 18 with Wraith Leggings, that poke starts threatening kills.
midlane.watchout: Gideon takes this lane — hold Fly Trap for the moment he commits and don't walk up to trade without Bramble Patch ready.

support.line: Sit behind your carry and drop Q Bramble Patch on the path between them and the enemy, then chip with E Harvest Nettles. Keep R Fly Trap for the moment they dive — Stonewall and Warden's Faith by minute 21 let you survive that.
support.watchout: With Fly Trap on cooldown you can't stop a dive alone — back off with your carry instead of trading.

carry.line: Throw RMB Vortex Grenade to slow them, then weave a basic attack after every cast — Gunslinger makes that next shot fire three times. Save E Rocket Dash to escape, not to engage; Viper and Deathstalker by minute 19 turn that rhythm into real damage.
carry.watchout: Most enemy carries win the straight trade — poke with Vaporize from max range and only step up when their abilities are spent.

carry.line: Land Q Peekaboo! first — it slows, reveals, and makes RMB Knock, Knock! hit far harder, so fire that next and finish with basics. Use E Surprise, Surprise! to reposition, not to run in; Viper and Deathstalker by minute 19 make the follow-up lethal.
carry.watchout: Miss Peekaboo! and you have no slow to hold them — against Murdock and Drongo, stay behind minions and wait for a better angle.

midlane.line: Poke with RMB Knock, Knock! from long range and clear minions with it, then commit only after Q Peekaboo! lands — the marked shot is your damage. Viper and Deathstalker by minute 18 make that pair actually kill.
midlane.watchout: Nearly every midlaner here beats you up close — farm from range, hold Surprise, Surprise! to escape, and take your kills roaming other lanes.

jungle.line: Open ganks in Spirit stance with RMB Windsurge to close and slow, then E Cyclebreaker for the stun and keep hitting — every fifth hit spawns a Clone. Switch stances with R 84000 Hairs mid-fight; Solaris and The Perforator by minute 25 sharpen the burst.
jungle.watchout: Almost every jungler here beats you in a straight duel — don't contest their camps; gank lanes and leave before help arrives.

jungle.line: Open with Q Lash Kick to yank yourself onto them and slow them hard, turn on E Windburn for the extra range and cleave, then keep attacking — Windburn's passive makes every third attack in a row deal bonus damage and heal you. Solaris, Viper and Spear Of Desolation by minute 25 make that chain finish kills.
jungle.watchout: You lose most jungle duels head-on — use RMB Backlash to turn away their shots and only fight when a teammate is already there.

jungle.line: Open with RMB Whispering Echoes to apply Soul Rip, then E Severance into that target — hitting a Soul Rip resets Severance so you can chase. Use Q Anima Burst to heal mid-fight; Viper and Solaris by minute 19 turn that chase into a kill.
jungle.watchout: Khaimera, Kwang and Feng Mao win a long fight — hit hard then leave with Severance rather than standing there trading.

offlane.line: Hold Q Barricade when they commit, then release it for the stun and follow with basic attacks — each hit stacks Gladiator for more power. Finish low targets with RMB Spear of Nyr, and take Krix so you survive the fights this build starts.
offlane.watchout: Blow Barricade too early and their engage lands free — hold it until they actually commit, then swing for the stun.

jungle.line: Gank with E Evade to close, hold Q Barricade through their answer, then release it for the stun and keep swinging as Gladiator stacks. Save R Coliseum for a target you can actually finish; Spear Of Desolation by minute 18 makes that likely.
jungle.watchout: Kwang trades evenly — don't force that duel alone; wait for a laner or take it after Barricade is back up.

support.line: Open with Q Ricochet to stun, drop E Bad Medicine on them, then heal with RMB Infuse — damaging heroes builds Triage Protocol and boosts those heals. Neural Regenesis is for the ally about to die; Lifecore by minute 22 makes every Infuse land harder.
support.watchout: Dekker, Riktor and Phase all beat this lane head-on — stay behind your carry and save Ricochet for their engage.

offlane.line: Open with Ricochet to stun, drop Bad Medicine under them for the slow and second burst, then keep basic attacking — Refibrillator's stacking burn is most of your damage. Oathkeeper lands at minute 19.
offlane.watchout: Every offlane checkpoint here goes to the enemy — farm safe, use Infuse and Neural Regenesis to keep allies alive, and don't duel.

midlane.line: Poke with Refibrillator basics so the burn keeps stacking, then Ricochet to stun and Bad Medicine on top for the slow and eruption. Save Neural Regenesis for whoever their team focuses; Oathkeeper lands at minute 18.
midlane.watchout: Every midlane checkpoint goes to the enemy — don't trade solo; play behind your jungler and win fights with Infuse and the revive.
